page.overview:
Who is Ashlee Smyt'hh?

Ashlee Smyt'hh is the mother of Veth Brenatto. She has not yet appeared on Critical Role.

At some point before 810 PD, Ashlee met T'ravys Smyt'hh and married him. The pair had four children, including Veth Brenatto.
